name: nuxt-i18n-micro
description: Nuxt I18n Micro is a lightweight, high-performance internationalization module for Nuxt, designed to handle multi-language support with minimal overhead, fast build times, and efficient runtime performance.

scripts.prepack: pnpm --filter "./packages/**" run build && nuxt-module-build build --stub && nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxt-module-build build && pnpm run client:build
scripts.dev:prepare: nuxt-module-build build --stub && nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxi prepare playground
scripts.release: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run release:patch
scripts.release:check: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:types && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:versions -- --npm && pnpm run compare:published
scripts.release:patch: pnpm run release:auth && pnpm run prepack && pnpm -C scripts cli release --bump patch && pnpm publish -r && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: pnpm run release:auth && pnpm run prepack && pnpm -C scripts cli release --bump minor && pnpm publish -r && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: pnpm run release:auth && pnpm run prepack && pnpm -C scripts cli release --bump major && pnpm publish -r && git push --follow-tags
scripts.lint: oxlint src packages test client playground scripts/src build.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint src packages test client playground scripts/src build.config.ts --fix
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src packages test client playground scripts/src build.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src packages test client playground scripts/src build.config.ts
scripts.clean: find . \( -name 'node_modules' -o -name '.nuxt' -o -name '.output' -o -name 'dist' \) -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . \( -name 'pnpm-lock.yaml' -o -name 'package-lock.json' \) -type f -exec rm -f '{}' +
scripts.clean:test: rm -rf test/.fixture-builds && find test/fixtures -type d \( -name '.nuxt' -o -name '.output-shared' -o -name '.nuxt-test' -o -name 'test-results' \) -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.docs:dev: pnpm run docs:generate && vitepress dev docs
scripts.docs:build: pnpm run docs:generate && vitepress build docs
scripts.docs:clean-dev: pnpm run docs:generate && vitepress dev docs --clean-cache

stackblitz.startCommand: pnpm install && pnpm --filter "./packages/**" run build && pnpm run dev:prepare && pnpm run dev
